finding: CLEAN. Zero exact overlap with the training universe, the matched reserve, or the external cohort as loaded. Zero genuine near-duplicates.
methodological_caveat_for_the_criterion: The same ECFP4 Tanimoto >= 0.95 criterion clusters near-duplicates in the reserve carve, where 192 of 106,530 clusters hold more than one source. Some of those merges may be this same alkane degeneracy. The direction is SAFE: spurious merging assigns a whole cluster to one side of the split, which is more conservative, not leakier. Worth stating in methods rather than discovering under review.
near_duplicate_candidates_were_all_finge: Six candidates flagged at Tanimoto 1.000 were all linear alkanes, C11 through C16, matching against OCTANE (C8H18). ECFP4 is degenerate for unbranched chains: past a few atoms the set of circular substructures stops changing, so undecane and hexadecane carry identical bit vectors despite being different molecules. Verified by canonical SMILES and molecular formula -- 0 of 6 are the same molecule. Reporting these as leakage would have been wrong.
raw_cohort_overlap_explained: 3 sources appear in both final_test and the RAW 16-shard panel file, and all 3 are inside the 6 declared validation-role precedence exclusions, so the cohort AS LOADED overlaps final_test by ZERO. The precedence machinery caught them as designed. This is not a leak.
recommended_action: None. No final_test source needs excluding. The role stays sealed.
